info.title: asset-review
info.description: Reusable local asset and wireframe approval review tool for PNG and SVG folders.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Launches a local PNG/SVG asset review app for the current workspace.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace root. Defaults to current directory.

options.name: --asset-root
options.description: Folder to scan for .png and .svg files. Defaults to workspace.

options.name: --generate-manifest
options.description:
Scan asset root for .png/.svg, write _manifest.md, and exit.
Does not infer storyboard sequences; existing Sequence sections are kept.

options.name: --embedded
options.description:
Launch the embedded Avalonia/WebView2 app (default).
--no-open, --server-only Start the local server without opening a UI.

options.name: --external-browser
options.description: Open the system browser instead of the embedded app.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the installed tool version and exit.
